title: Curve-Primary
slide_intent: Choose acceleration deliberately because people read the start and stop of a movement as character.
strategic_value: The primary curve’s energetic start and soft stop can give DB movement a consistent sense of decisiveness.
demonstration: A red square travels horizontally beside a red easing graph with a moving position marker.
practical_value: Use the primary curve for the leading movement and compare its progress with the plotted curve.
